title: POST connection/oauth-client request (signed, Idempotency-Key)
description: The store asks for its OAuth client once the heartbeat advertises oauth: a confidential client of this outlet with the scopes profile and store:link, PKCE (S256) required. redirect_uri is the store's callback (its home URL with ?pixalink_oauth=callback); it must be on the outlet's connected store host, or the answer is 422 invalid_redirect_uri. Every call rotates the client: the previous secret stops working.
